The real highlight, however, is its constant, direct access to the picturesque canal.Other ProjectsDubai, United Arab EmiratesDG1DG1 is located in the heart of Downtown Dubai directly by the canal.View All ProjectsFrequently Asked QuestionsWhat is Urban Oasis by Missoni?Urban Oasis by Missoni is a completed branded residential tower on the Dubai Canal, developed by DarGlobal. Missoni provided the interior design across the tower's one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments and penthouses, bringing the Italian fashion house's signature aesthetic to a waterfront address in the heart of Dubai.What did Missoni design at Urban Oasis?Missoni's design team was responsible for the interiors throughout Urban Oasis, applying the brand's approach to colour, pattern, and material quality across living spaces, bedrooms, and kitchens. The design concept draws on the energy of Miami Beach living, translated into a canal-facing Dubai address.Is Urban Oasis by Missoni sold out?Yes. Urban Oasis by Missoni is sold out. The project is fully completed and delivered. Buyers interested in current DarGlobal projects or potential resale units can contact DarGlobal directly through darglobal.co.uk.Where is Urban Oasis by Missoni located?The tower sits directly on the Dubai Canal, placing it 5 minutes from Downtown Dubai and Dubai Mall, 7 minutes from Jumeirah Beach, and 17 minutes from both Dubai International Airport and Dubai Marina. The canal-front position gives residents constant waterfront access alongside immediate connectivity to the city's key destinations.What unit types are available at Urban Oasis by Missoni?The tower comprises one-, two-, and three-bedroom residences alongside penthouses accessed via private elevators. Units feature closed kitchens, expansive bedrooms with en-suite bathrooms, and 360-degree views of the Dubai Canal and city skyline. The project is sold out and fully handed over.What amenities does Urban Oasis by Missoni offer?Amenities include an infinity pool, cutting-edge gym, grand entrance lobby, ground-floor retail, covered parking, and 24/7 concierge services. The tower sits directly on the Dubai Canal, providing immediate waterfront access as a lifestyle amenity in itself.What was the investment case for Urban Oasis by Missoni?Urban Oasis by Missoni offered a Missoni-branded waterfront address on the Dubai Canal, a corridor that has seen strong capital appreciation as Business Bay has matured into one of Dubai's premier residential and commercial districts. Dubai offers 0% income tax, 0% property tax, and a 10-year Golden Visa with qualifying investments of 2 million AED or more.How does Urban Oasis by Missoni compare to other branded projects on the Dubai Canal?Urban Oasis is one of few completed, fully delivered branded residences with direct canal frontage in Business Bay. Its combination of an Italian fashion brand interior, private elevator penthouses, and 360-degree canal and city views placed it in a distinct segment of the Dubai branded residence market.Can I buy a resale unit at Urban Oasis by Missoni?As the project is sold out at the developer level, any available units would be on the secondary market. DarGlobal can advise on current availability or direct interested buyers to appropriate channels. Contact the team at darglobal.co.uk for further information.What other DarGlobal branded residence projects are available in Dubai?DarGlobal has developed multiple branded residential projects in Dubai and across the region, including Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai and DG1 on the Dubai Canal.
